grading.model: Claude Opus 5.5 for the lister and the prove and disprove passes; the author's session is Claude Fable 5.1 of the same family
grading.method: Cited-sources profile. The lister took every checkable statement from the page text. Two passes with a strong model over saved copies only, no live fetch: a prove pass (does the saved copy of THAT cited source carry the same figure, date, entity, measure or words) and a disprove pass (does a cited source or the page itself say the opposite). Verdict rule: CONTRADICTED if the disprove pass found a contradiction, else EVIDENCED if the prove pass found an artefact, else NO EVIDENCE PUBLISHED. A holdout graded by the orchestrator before any pass result gated each run (see gates). This is a check of the brief against its own sources, not an independent audit.
